articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Hillman Sets Fourth Quarter 2025 Earnings Release and Results Presentation Date. CINCINNATI, Jan. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Hillman Solutions Corp. (Nasdaq: HLMN) (“Hillman”), a leading provider of hardware-related products and merchandising solutions, plans to host a conference call to discuss its results for the thirteen and fifty-two weeks ended December 27, 2025 on Tuesday, February 17, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time.
